item.title: Parkside Commons in Syracuse set for major revamp
item.description: The new owners of Parkside Commons in Syracuse, NY have taken steps to improve safety and security, and plan to demolish four buildings and add two new ones, while rehabilitating six existing buildings, in order to create a safer and more affordable living environment for the existing residents.

item.title: Therapy dog still number one in Central New Yorkers' hearts, despite elimination from Westminster Dog Show
item.description: Bodhi, a therapy dog from Syracuse, competed in the Retriever class at the Westminster Kennel Club Dog Show, advancing to the second round before being eliminated, but is still celebrated for being one of the nation's top Golden Retrievers to compete.
